alternatives.root_cause: email's listen address/port configuration value was set empty, making it refuse to bind.
alternatives.why_not: The change log shows only image-reference churn on email and no configuration edit; the empty bind URI arrives together with the wrong artifact, so the artifact is the proximate wrongness.

alternatives.root_cause: checkout itself is broken and failing to complete orders.
alternatives.why_not: checkout has no change record and all other downstreams respond normally in-trace; its only error is the outbound hop to email, which resolves to nothing.

alternatives.root_cause: email's process is frozen while its socket still accepts, so callers hang.
alternatives.why_not: email is not silent — it writes a repeating startup fatal error — and checkout fails fast on name resolution rather than hanging to a deadline.

verdict.summary: email was redeployed at 04:20 with an image reference pointing at the wrong artifact (a quote-service build), whose process crash-loops on startup, so email never came up and checkout's calls to it failed.
verdict.reasoning: checkout alerted first but its own traces (tr_8dbdf108e728) show every failing PlaceOrder succeeding through cart, currency, product-catalog, payment and shipping and erroring only on the outbound call to email, failing at name resolution rather than on a timeout — a caller-side symptom of a callee that never came up. The change log (tr_970ec5689002) shows email's image reference repeatedly flipped to a build belonging to another component, with the latest flip at 04:20:25, minutes before onset at 04:25:46. email's own logs (tr_afe764214a78) show normal order-confirmation handling early in the window and then a repeating startup fatal error on an invalid listen URI, once per minute — a crash-loop, i.e. the running artifact cannot start. That artifact mismatch, not a configuration value edited in place or a resource limit, is the failing mechanism, so bad_deploy. checkout logging nothing (tr_983c2bf684fe) is consistent with it being a propagation victim surfacing errors only in spans.
open_questions: Whether the empty bind URI comes from the wrong image expecting different environment variables or from a separate configuration edit not captured in the change log.
Why platform-automation repeatedly applies and reverts this image reference — the trigger for the loop is unexplained.
Whether the earlier revert at 04:07 restored service, which would confirm rollback as the fix.
